Welcome to the whimsical universe of [i]Twinkleby[/i], where you explore a starlit archipelago of floating islands and decorate delightful dioramas. 

We are incredibly happy to say that our cozy game [b][i]Twinkleby[/i][/b] has been released today on PC, Mac, and Linux with full Steam Deck compatibility; for $16.99 USD / £14.29 GBP / €16.49 EUR; with a 15% Launch discount until October 3rd!

Just relax and decorate to your heart's desires with a wide range of tools at hand. Build tiny neighbourhoods, furnish the houses, and set the stage by changing the weather, seasons, and other intricate scenery details.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][b]Get Twinkleby on Steam![/b][/url] 
(15% Launch Sale up until October 3rd)

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5IElqQZJ0o]Watch the [i]Twinkleby[/i] Release Trailer![/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0tvQLF21_o8]Watch the Fall asleep while I play Twinkleby (Full Game) with MadMorph[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/7995d4a82a71ac39e8de2fd6cce3e155982ae283.jpg[/img][/url]

However, you are not decorating only for yourself in [i]Twinkleby[/i]! Your creative choices will attract an ever-changing cast of adorable Neighbours that will make themselves at home on your cozy islands. Try to make these rascals happy or evict them, and send them floating off into the starlit skies with their tiny umbrellas!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/4349446cf3d48222bcaa9157a00abfeff55f6786.jpg[/img][/url]

Oh, but that´s not all! Two bundles have also been launched today on Steam that gives an additional 10% off the price!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58650]Twinkleby + Camper Van Bundle[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59486/]Twinkleby + Townscaper Bundle[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/2fc83751f3435dc5779a832f3c0231b66428e83f.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]About [i]Twinkleby[/i][/b]

Put your dazzling decoration skills to the test for your cute Neighbours and make them feel at home in your dapper dioramas. Feed them delicious food and fill their time with fun activities. No stress at all when it comes to satisfying their desires, as they will settle in on their own until you get around to giving them what they want.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/b50c6c0dd84b3d5efead3ce93d028abea32d1c11.jpg[/img][/url]

If your tiny friends overstay their welcome, just toss their bags off the island. They’ll take the hint, jump off the side of the island and soar away through the sky.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/3bb4d7d68b10477674c7e8b38a335cc150ef054e.jpg[/img][/url]

Expand your collection of shiny antiques and stylish garden decorations as you play. If you want to redo any part of your design, simply throw any item off the island’s edge and it'll be safely returned to your inventory.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/ec0cbc3e94853696d690638412243f9dfc2d598e.jpg[/img][/url]

Explore your starlit archipelago and unlock a smorgasbord of customization features, including a variety of weathers, seasons, backdrops as well as a colour palette for both your houses and all your decorative items. As you shape your islands in Twinkleby, you also change the soundtrack and gradually gain full control over the ambience of your dreamscape.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/92c50a7950095983ee3bd95c345781f77018d9fd.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Twinkleby Key Features:[/b]
✦ Aim for the stars – Follow the Twinkleby star chart to unlock new islands and collect map fragments to discover hidden ones.
✦ A smorgasbord of decoration – Grow your item collection and freely swap designs by tossing items over the island's edge, which are safely returned to your inventory.
✦ Decorate for your Neighbours – Attract both common and rare Neighbours, where the rare ones are drawn to your islands by how you decorate. If you tire of their company, simply send them on their way.
✦ Kindness is king – Make your Neighbours happy and they’ll reward you with gifts, from paintings and treasure keys to map fragments that leads to hidden islands.
✦ The soundtrack of your islands – Tailor ambience through weather, seasons, and backdrops, creating a unique soundscape for each island.
✦ Collect falling stars – Collect shooting stars known as Stellars and spend them at Molligan’s Antiques on new decorations. Earn more by delighting your Neighbours and uncovering secret ways to bring more stars tumbling from the sky.
✦ Keep a look-out for gifts from the skies – Claim chests that tumble past your islands and unlock new treasures for your collection.
✦ Take pretty pictures of your creations – Be sure to memorize your dazzling decorations in photo mode to capture all your delightful designs.
✦ Parallel islands – When you have delved deep into the Twinkleby universe, you will be able to play on new clean-slate versions of the islands you've discovered. Find new creative ways to decorate with all the items you've gathered!
✦ Sit back and relax – Enjoy stress-free, escapist gameplay without fail states or game overs.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/68be47ea7ee76697fbdec0b3768eb3b2ada4ea9a.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/800049297939f75636aca44903e8cf2ab9083a30.jpg[/img][/url]

We wish you all an amazing time in our cozy game Twinkleby 
All the very best from the devs at the indie studio Might & Delight 💖

Ever dreamed of decorating your own floating sky archipelago filled with curious creatures and peculiar antiques? We are incredibly happy to say that [i]Twinkleby[/i]—our upcoming cozy, quirky indie game — was spotlighted as “Ones to Play” during the Future Games Show at gamescom 2025! 🎉

[url=https://youtu.be/YkGKkpufaS8?si=xRNsFAMzYgGN1Pp5&t=10]Watch “Ones to Play” at the Future Games Show 2025[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow]Explore the Future Games Show Steam Event here![/url]

In [i]Twinkleby,[/i] you are invited into a starlit world where creativity knows no bounds. Decorate enchanting homes and gardens — whether charming, adorable, eccentric, or delightfully strange — and watch as whimsical residents arrive to settle on your islands, each drawn to your unique sense of style.

[i]Twinkleby [/i]is set to launch this fall on PC, Mac, and Linux, with full Steam Deck compatibility.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/1458b1fb97592336886cf88869ab695331cbba87.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]About [i]Twinkleby[/i][/b]

In [i]Twinkleby[/i], the whole world is your inventory. Here you can rebuild, redesign, discover new items and unlock a wide range of customization, including colors, backdrops, weathers and seasons. As you customize the scenery, you also change the soundtrack of your dreamscapes.

Based on your decoration choices, tiny neighbors will soon arrive on flying boats. Be aware that some are incredibly rare and only the most dedicated player will collect them all. If you feel your island is getting too crowded, simply throw your residents bags off the side of the island, and they’ll take the hint and soar away through the air. 

However, it might be a good idea to not be too hasty to say goodbye to them, since your tiny friends carry gifts for you if you make them happy. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/ae1e8385fd1c2364cc3d4baad588e4164e42730d.jpg[/img][/url]


If you suddenly want to shake things up, there´s a twist. You can simply toss your houses and items over the island’s edge! Don´t worry, anything thrown away will be safely returned to your collection. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/1689aa8ae7abf7d458a8b34b552bb66490fa1db5.jpg[/img][/url]

Of course, you can still decorate each of your islands to perfection and travel further along the Twinkleby star chart in search of new friends and lost islands.

notes.title: Back on Track: Might & Delight's Journey Forward
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/be45d9fb15777f15d89abe0a10c17c3ce0c42b55.jpg[/img]

As you may know, the video game industry is weathering a storm, and the team at Might & Delight have unfortunately not been spared from it. 

Earlier this year, we had to make the incredibly difficult decision to scale down our team. It has been a rough year, and we’ve been silent on our social channels as we’ve been focused on our team – both the friends that we’ve had to say goodbye to, and the team that remains. We’re still settling into our new normal, but we wanted to let you know that we are here, we´re working on our games and there are some things that we want to share with you.

We’ve been around for nearly fifteen years as an indie game developer, and we have a long, proud history of making games. We believe in game preservation and we aim to make sure our games are available to anyone who has supported us throughout the years. As we make decisions for existing titles and future projects, please know that this will be our guiding principle.

Our team is smaller now, and we will need to be mindful of how many projects we work on simultaneously to ensure that we keep our team healthy and our projects manageable. However, our intention is to keep up maintenance of our existing titles, as well as finish development of projects that have been in the pipeline for a while.

Regarding [i]Book of Travels,[/i] our main focus for the foreseeable future will be to roll out several patches that are in the making – including fixes and community requests – and we’re also aiming to, among other things, do a balancing pass for the inventory, and look into releasing some map updates. During the next couple of months, you’ll notice our activity picking up on Discord and Steam. We want you to know that we are here, we listen to your feedback and we’ll do our very best to keep you all in the loop as we roll out future patches.

We are excited to say that we have a new game project slated for release in the fall of 2025. When we were a bigger team, we worked on the concept of this game in parallel for a couple of years, and at the time of writing this, we’re already halfway through development. We look forward to sharing more about it with you in the new year. For now, however, our main focus will be on our existing game catalogue.

Also, for all you lovely people who supported[i] Book of Travels[/i] on Kickstarter; please keep an eye on Kickstarter updates and/or your inbox. Beyond upcoming Steam updates, we will also be sharing some information directly with all backers early next year. 

Throughout this year, the one thing we’ve always come back to is the fact that we have such an incredible community. We’re not exaggerating when we say that you are the main reason that we have managed to weather all the changes of 2024, and fight for a chance to not only continue the support of our previous games, but also to be able to release something new. 

A studio is only as good as its players, and we’re incredibly proud to have your support. Know that you can expect to see a lot more from us from now on. 

2024 has been a turbulent and chaotic year (for many, not just in the video game industry) so we want to wish you all a peaceful and cosy end of the year. We really hope to start off 2025 with a sense of normalcy, and we want to be more active – both with our online presence, and with our upcoming patches and announcements. 

Have an amazing Holiday and we’ll be in touch soon ❤
Cheers from all the developers at Might & Delight

notes.title: A Message from the Team
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Shelter Lovers,[/h2]

After the hecticness of launch we wanted to pop in and respond to some of your reviews and feedback. Thank you, as always, for posting them - good and bad!

As some of you have pointed out, we did indeed design Shelter 3 as a different kind of game to its predecessors, and that was a conscious decision - we wanted to explore something new. Choosing elephants as our protagonists was an early expression of that direction: we liked that elephants are neither fast nor hunters and that their empathy and collective will make for characteristics we could design for. But in the end the game could work better, and this is a fact that can only be explained by the complexity of running development schedules for two games simultaneously. Without a doubt, building Book of Travels simultaneously has stretched our team wide and left some aspects lacking in Shelter 3.

So we're here to say that we're genuinely so sorry to hear that fans have been disappointed (we hear you) and we’re incredibly grateful to those who have stuck with us despite the hiccups and deficits they found in their game experience. We hope it helps you to know that our first patch is already up and that we will continue with a scheduled plan of patches as well as bug fixes. Now, as previously, we value your feedback and will act on it where we can.

But we should be clear that beyond fixes, Shelter 3 won’t change much. We hope that your replay experiences will bring you more satisfaction... If you’re one of the players who reviewed Shelter 3 well, thank you for spreading positive energies, as a growing and niche studio, we need and value your support in all its forms!

Thanks again for sticking with us.

[b]Best Wishes

Helen & the Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Shelter 3 shows off its baby elephants in first gameplay trailer
notes.notes:
Developer Might and Delight has shared a first gameplay trailer of Shelter 3, the latest entry in its long-running open-world nature series, which this time casts players as a mother elephant who must protect her calf, and indeed the entire herd, from harm.

Despite the change in animal (Shelter 2 followed the adventures of a lynx and her cubs, while the first game starred a family of badgers), Shelter 3 offers a similar structure to its predecessors, blending open-world exploration and survival. Here, though, the journey leads your herd across the savannah, on the hunt for new pastures while avoiding natural dangers, including crocodiles and tigers. You'll find some of that in Shelter 3's first gameplay trailer below.

"Help the matriarch by choosing the best route to keep your herd well fed and safe from harm," explains Might and Delight. "You'll use ancient knowledge to navigate, gaining wisdom as you do so. As an elephant you're not a predator but prey, so you'll need to steer clear of beasts in the bushes at the same time as avoiding starvation...Your journey will be scattered with special moments as you discover new terrain and untrodden pathways, but grief will also play its part."

notes.title: Scoring Shelter Games
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

The release of Shelter 3 is just on the horizon, and in the third of our posts celebrating its predecessors, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/977630]Shelter 3[/url], we’re exploring the musical style that’s such a huge part of the personality of Shelter games. And to share in full spirit, we’re [b]giving away the full Shelter 2 soundtrack[/b] as a free gift in our [url=https://shelter.mightanddelight.com. ]Shelter newsletter[/url]. We could all use a little musical sunshine in these dark days! Take a listen to the theme song right here...
[previewyoutube=_Pc3V85_ez4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Scoring for Wilderness[/h2]
 
The soundtracks for all Shelter games are composed and performed by [b]Swedish band Retro Family, [/b]who work in close collaboration with the developers. Shelter’s uniquely loose and live sound began as a quest for “a sound that would blend nicely with the ambience of nature” says Sound Designer Josef Tuulse, “I also wanted to leave space in the spectrum for the calls of the badgers. We came up with a soundtrack that was [b]quite heavy on the low end and shimmering in the highs[/b], where the voice of the guitar can express freely and comment on the narrative.” 

In life and in gameplay, intuition is what being an animal is all about, and [b]an intuitive, emotive approach also leads the musical composition[/b]. Retro Family’s Ulf Wahlgren explains: “Jokke is very good at creating sounds and feelings in the studio, so it's more about that then the actual instruments for Shelter.” The studio’s philosophy is to leave the player to interpret their play experience, and sound design plays a big role in setting that tone. As Ulf says, “The music for Shelter is about 25% avant-garde, I always feel that this genre [b]lets the listener decide what it feels like[/b]. White noise will be beautiful and soothing to some, yet scary and claustrophobic to others.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/7f7abb26c52f2bf56c397b01110bda77fa511df3.png[/img]

[h2]Music for Elephants[/h2]
 
Due for release in quarter two this year, Shelter 3 will see the series move from tundra to jungle and from lynx family to elephant herd. So what might we expect from a Shelter 3 soundtrack? “We want to give players all the comfort of returning to the Shelter universe as well as something new,” says Josef, “Elephants are [b]big and heavy but also gentle and caring.[/b] It's our aim to give these same qualities to the music”
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/502aad74261b8315879d06dec6e739e84b0f23c8.png[/img]
 
[h2]Celebrating music in our games[/h2]
 
[b]Retro Family are Ulf Wahlgren, Jokke Pettersson and Alfred Andersson [/b]and are also working on music for Book of Travels which we’ve also featured in this week’s Steam post. You can watch some studio jams at Retro Family’s [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAoe5b6PCwDIcpI_-cRgItw]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/retrofamilymusic/]Instagram[/url]. 
 
We’d love to hear what you think about the music in any of our games - what do you like about it? What does it remind you of?[b] Let us know right here in the comments[/b] or drop us a line in the Youtube video comments box! 
 
If you’re new to Shelter Games we’d love to hear from you. Say hello in the comments right here and we’ll pop in to respond! And to find out more about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/244710/Shelter/]Shelter[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/275100/Shelter_2/]Shelter 2[/url] and more, check out this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977630/Shelter_3/]overview,[/url] or take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977630/Shelter_3/]Shelter books and unlockable DLCs[/url].
 
That’s all for now, thank you so much for spending time with us!

Helen and the Shelter Team

notes.title: A Game Dev Journey in Three Animals
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
Thanks to the [i]Book of Travels[/i][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bookoftravels/book-of-travels-a-serene-online-rpg] Kickstarter[/url], we've seen many [b]new players in the world of Shelter this last year,[/b] so if you're one of them (or even if you're a Shelter officiando!), we think you'll find something to like in this little guide. And in the weeks to come, we'll be sharing more stories and fun facts about the series. (And if you haven't already, you can wishlist the game with the button at the end of this post.)

[h3]Badgers! The very first Shelter game[/h3]
[i]Shelter[/i] was released in 2013, and was [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mightanddelight/]Might and Delight’s[/url][/b] second release as a newly formed studio. You can watch the Announce trailer here:

[previewyoutube=ifMWBd4CIZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What are its defining features?  [/h3][list][*] [i]Shelter[/i] is a linear adventure where you play as a badger looking after her cubs
[*] The setting is both naturalistic and harsh – threats and dangers are many, and bereavement is highly likely
[*] The game’s graphical style – nature inspired geometrical patterns and textures – sets it apart from other animal games[/list]
[h3]What the developers say[/h3]
[i]“We knew we wanted to make a game with an animal-player and we’d intended to make something casual and somewhat quiet. In the end we had something that was both of those things but also very emotional, and it reached a much wider audience than we’d hoped for. We had no idea we’d be here, seven years later, working on Shelter 3!”[/i] 
– [b]Andreas Wangler,[/b] Game Designer

[h3]What the players say[/h3]
[i]“I didn’t care about my little cubs because the game told me to or because they were labelled my babies. I cared due to the way they followed me, how small they were, the little noises they made, and how quickly the hostile world around me took them away” [/i]
– [b]Wirdjos[/b] on Discord 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/244710/Shelter

[h2]Lynx! Protect your cubs in Shelter 2[/h2]
[i]Shelter 2[/i] was released in 2015 from our current site on an island in Stockholm. 

[previewyoutube=Tk-1M1wNVDY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What are its defining features?[/h3][list][*][i] Shelter 2[/i] is non-linear and open world: expect a greater variety of story experiences
[*] Players meet a somewhat more gentle (but no less moving) ending than they do in [i]Shelter[/i]
[*] Not all aspects of the game are informed by naturalistic observations – mysterious occurrences feature
[*] As opposed to [i]Shelter[/i], food is a moving target, players need to hunt to stay alive 
[*] Shelter 2 has a higher graphical profile and is the first Might and Delight game to be published on Switch[/list]
[h3]What the developers say [/h3]
[i]“Shelter 2 was an opportunity to explore a much less linear game design, instead we wanted to invite players to roam freely with no other goal than to rear their cubs to adulthood. We also wanted to introduce something a bit mysterious and otherworldly into the game” [/i]
[b]– Peter Stråhle[/b], 2D Artis

[h3]What the players say[/h3]
[i]“It's not just about motherhood and nature exposed in such a raw but gentle way, it's about the discovery of life through these young creatures whose life cycle revolves around finding their home, their Shelter” [/i]
[b]– Pencil[/b] on Discord

http://store.steampowered.com/app/275100/Shelter_2/

[h2]Elephants! Lead the herd in Shelter 3 [/h2]
[i]Shelter 3’[/i]s due for release on Q1 of 2021 - elephants are already roaming and testing is well under way.

[previewyoutube=UmqrVpFa2OU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What are its defining features?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The third in the series has players looking after a whole herd of elephants
[*] As a result, play will be slower, but the need for food will be even more pressing
[*] Players will enjoy a sense of community with other elephants
[*] The theme shifts from motherhood and family to legacy and inheritance[/list]
[h3]What the developers say[/h3]
[i]“Until now, Shelter games have focussed on animal families. With [i]Shelter 3[/i], we had a strong feeling that we wanted to make a Shelter experience that’s more social – elephants are incredibly sociable and that allows us to create a very different game experience”[/i] 
[b]– Sofia Papworth[/b], Lead Programmer

[h3]What the players say[/h3]
We're too early for player testimonies, but we’d love to know what you think about our plans for[i] Shelter 3[/i] – please drop us a line or two in the comments section here or join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Yq9C8Yf]Discord[/url]!

Did you know that there's also a multiplayer game from the Shelter world, called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/486310/Meadow/]Meadow[/url]? In Meadow you can meet other players and communicate with emotes, but we'll save that for another post!

notes.notes:
Announcing a new game on April 1st seems like a foolish prospect to me, but Might And Delight reckon that now is the best time to unveil Shelter 3 to the world, due for release in 2020. While the first two games focused on the fragility of life as a badger and lynx respectively, this time the player has a big role to play – an elephant. You’ll be leading their herd through the jungle and across the plains, and protecting the young from predators. It’s also a look at a more social breed of animal, with the previous two games being solitary, tense stories. Below, the announcement trailer.
